thread:
kevin: :rotating_light: Pager fired — multiple pods on prod-gpu-03 are CrashLoopBackOffing with SIGSEGV in the runtime/engine. Happening since ~03:14 UTC. Affected service: inference-api, model: trt-llm-v3. Pods restarting ~ every 20s.

sre-bot: INCIDENT created (inc-2026-03-15-224). Severity: P1. Pager: @oncall-maria. Paging channel: #incidents.

oncall-maria: ack — I'm on it. Pulling logs now, will triage.

kevin: logs from one of the pods pasted below (tail -n 200). multiple segfault backtraces, then `CUDA error: illegal memory access`.

kevin: ```
[   03.142345] inference-runtime[2543]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f8b1c2d1f2a sp 00007ffd8f2a6c10 error 4 in fused_kernels.so[7f8b1c1f0000+23000]
[   03.142348] inference-runtime[2543]: CUDA error 77 (an illegal memory access was encountered) at runtime/engine/trt_executor.cu:412
[   03.142349] inference-runtime[2543]: aborting due to fatal runtime error
```

oncall-maria: kubectl describe & logs show crashloop with OOM occasionally right before segfault, and then a hard segfault. Pod events: `OOMKilled` + `Back-off restarting failed container`.

infra-ops-jasmin: node metrics (prod-gpu-03) show GPU memory saturation on the relevant GPU, but not full across all processes — looks like memory corruption on allocation path.

eng-runtime-lee: digging in. Likely culprit: the new fused attention kernel we rolled in runtime:v3.2. Some initial reports of illegal memaccess on certain sequence lengths + mixed-precision / TensorRT path.

kevin: reproduction attempt on staging with same sequence lengths reproduces segfault in fused_kernels.so inside `attention_forward()` when running with TensorRT optimization flags.

eng-runtime-lee: immediate mitigations we can do: 
- scale inference-api replicas for trt-llm-v3 to 0 for prod-gpu-03 to stop restarts (fast mitigation)
- route live traffic for the model to fallback variant (trt-llm-v2-stable) via routing policy in infra config
- set env var FORCE_CPU_FALLBACK=1 on the deployment as a quick workaround (forces non-fused path)

oncall-maria: performing scale down now. `kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-api-trt-llm-v3 --replicas=0` -> done. Pods stopped restarting on node. :white_check_mark:

product-ops: observing customer impact — ~12% error rate anomaly on the hosted inference API for the last 7 minutes; about 80 requests/min hitting the affected variant. We'll draft a status page update if mitigation holds.

statusbot: STATUSPAGE DRAFT: "We are investigating an issue causing intermittent inference errors for model trt-llm-v3. A mitigation has been applied to route traffic to a stable variant." Please confirm.

kevin: confirm — publish. Call out that impact window started ~03:14 UTC and affected small subset of customers using v3.

eng-runtime-lee: gathering repro artifacts. Attaching the gdb backtrace from a coredump we collected before scaling down: 
```
#0  0x00007f8b1c2d1f2a in attention_forward(fptr=0x7f8b1c1f0, args=0x7ff... )
#1  0x00007f8b1c202f8b in fused_forward
#2  0x0000555556a1c4b2 in trt_exec::run()
#3  0x00005555569f3d1a in main_inference_loop
```

eng-runtime-lee: hypothesis: race in workspace allocation when certain seq_len + batch_size triggers tensor aliasing in the fused kernel under mixed precision. Also seeing a pattern with TensorRT 8.6 + driver 535.*

infra-ops-jasmin: node-level temporary mitigation: cordon prod-gpu-03 to prevent new pods from landing. `kubectl cordon prod-gpu-03` -> cordoned. We'll also drain any non-critical pods off it.

oncall-maria: applied runtime env patch for other replicas: set `FORCE_CPU_FALLBACK=1` on inference-api-deployments that are healthy; redeploys in progress. This will cost CPU, but preserves availability.

eng-runtime-lee: next actions: rollback runtime image for trt-llm-v3 to v3.1 which didn't include the fused kernel OR patch fused_kernels to add bounds checks. Hotpatch ETA: 2-3 hours for a safe release; rollback is faster (~15-30 mins). Recommend rollback as the immediate fix.

kevin: opted for rollback to minimize risk. Initiating rollout: `kubectl set image deploy/inference-api-trt-llm-v3 inference-runtime=runtime:v3.1 --record` and reconciling routing.

infra-ops-jasmin: after scaling back up to replicas=3 on alternate nodes and routing to v3.1, pods stayed stable and no further segfaults observed for 10m. :tada:

product-ops: publishing status update now. Notifying customers in affected orgs via email and account success.

statusbot: STATUSPAGE POSTED: incident page updated with mitigation and rollback info.

oncall-maria: handing off to @eng-runtime-lee for root cause and postmortem. I'm going back to monitor for 30m then will join postmortem.

eng-runtime-lee: ack — taking ownership for RCA, root cause work and patch. Will file tracking issue and candidate postmortem doc.

kevin: notes for postmortem: include sequence lengths / batch sizes that reproduce, TRT and driver versions (TensorRT 8.6.*, NVIDIA driver 535.*), memory inspector logs, coredump + gdb backtrace, and decision timeline (scale down -> FORCE_CPU_FALLBACK -> rollback to v3.1).

infra-ops-jasmin: we'll preserve prod-gpu-03 state (don't reboot) until eng-runtime confirms we've pulled all needed artifacts.

kevin: thanks everyone. Final status here: production impact mitigated via rollback & traffic routing; ongoing RCA/patching owned by eng-runtime-lee.

eng-runtime-lee: ETA for postmortem draft: EOD. Assigning action items in the tracking issue.

product-ops: linking customers notified + issued credits as appropriate, will coordinate follow-up comms after RCA.

sre-bot: INCIDENT inc-2026-03-15-224 moved to status: mitigated. Pager clear unless reactivated.

oncall-maria: closing handoff. If anything spikes, ping me directly.

kevin: :thumbsup:
